IC1: 1. Patient has an allergy to nickel.
IC2: 2. Patient has a diagnosis of bowel obstruction [OR], bowel strangulation [OR], peritonitis [OR], bowel perforation [OR], local [OR] or systemic infection [OR], ischemic bowel [OR], carcinomatosis [OR] or extensively spread inflammatory bowel disease.
IC3: 3. Patient is participating in another clinical trial which may affect this study's outcomes.
IC4: 4. Patient has been taking regular steroid medication.
IC5: 5. Patient has contraindications to general anesthesia.
IC6: 6. Patient has preexisting sphincter problems [OR] or evidence of extensive local disease in the pelvis.
